ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 88% high-intensity white field with a 12% low-intensity black margin and focal spot distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; discrete high-contrast dark circular blobs (12-15 count) distributed irregularly across the central white field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle relative to the horizontal fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern characterized by jagged peaks and valleys (5-10 pixel amplitude) along the entire posterior boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the outer margins tapering to sharp lateral points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters appearing as dark annular rings; concentrated in the lower-mid region of the right lobe and upper-mid region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct low-intensity linear marks; notably two parallel diagonal streaks on the left lobe and horizontal scratches near the trailing edge midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-contrast textured calcifications/encrustations at the extreme distal tips; visible yellowish-brown pigmentation staining at the base of the lobes near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical pair of dark focal spots located on the proximal surface immediately adjacent to the median notch base.
